relevance_note: The paper describes 23 in-scope individuals with genetically confirmed SSADHD individually, e.g. 'Each participant from the SSADHD group had at least one area of abnormal myelination'.
method_note: Read the Markdown full text only; no script was used, so Table 4 (patients as rows, indexed by its '#' column, 1-23) was transcribed by hand and cross-checked against the text. Table 4 has no patient-label column, so labels are 'Table 4 #<value>'. Em dash ('-') cells (medications, ALDH5A1 expression, plasma GHB, MRS) are not defined as absent in the legend, so they were recorded as 'not reported'. No Table 4 cell uses the ' / ' stacked-value separator; the medication cells of patients #5, #9, #10, #18, #20, #21, #22 and #23 hold two line-broken values inside one cell, both belonging to that same patient. Table 4 has no sex column and Table 3 gives sex only as a group count (12/11), so sex is 'not reported' for every individual. Zygosity is never stated (only 'Pathogenic variant 1' and 'Pathogenic variant 2' columns), so zygosity is 'not reported'; patients whose two columns print the same string (#9, #10, #13, #14, #18, #19) get a single variant row. The 'Structure/function affected in protein (SSADH)' column is an in silico result for that participant's variant combination and was recorded as functional evidence. 'Pathogenic' comes from the printed column headers. Age at last evaluation is the printed Table 4 age in years; ISO values are that number converted to years and months. 'Movement disorders: No' was taken to exclude the four specific movement-disorder checklist items (ataxia, dystonia, exertional dyskinesia, hemiballismus); 'Movement disorders: Yes' and 'Behavior problems: Yes/No' were not mapped onto any checklist item, because the paper does not say which movement disorder or which behaviour it means. 'T2 hyperintensity of globus pallidus, subthalamic or dentate nuclei on MRI' was left 'not reported' although the paper reports dysmyelination of the dentate nucleus and basal ganglia. hpo_label_candidate and hpo_id_candidate were left null for all rows because no term could be assigned with confidence. Two previously published persons mentioned only in passing but with an individual-level finding were included: the post-mortem patient of refs [32, 33] and the G-ratio individual of ref [53]. No contradictions inside the paper were found. The 21 healthy controls are out of scope (cohort_size_as_stated = 44).
